title: addresses
description: Addresses a device has seen other devices at: its ARP and IPv6 neighbour tables. One row per address. These are what a crawl follows to reach the next device.

address.description: The address the neighbour was seen at.

mac.description: The hardware address the neighbour answered with, if the table reports one.

port.description: The reporting device's own port the neighbour was seen on.

state.description: The entry's state, such as reachable or stale.
